body: claimed: issue-worker-high (claude-opus-5-5) · 2026-11-13T16:41Z · worktree/branch issue/1453-left-hand-tap · plan: settle whether a left-hand tap can be set up, then fix or refuse it in every tapping post

Answer to the question in this issue: **no - a left-hand tap cannot be set up today.** Read on origin/main at af711f4bf (after PR 1435). Every route a tap takes to the post carries no hand and no reverse spindle:

- **The tool.** `crates/tools/src/tools.rs`: a `ToolKind::Tap` has `pitch: f64`, and the sanity law asks `pitch > 0.0` (line ~313) and `rpm > 0.0` for every spinning kind (line ~298). There is no hand or direction field on `Tool`, and a negative pitch or rpm is refused, so neither can stand in for one. The catalog import (`catalog_asset.rs`) has no hand key either.
- **The operation.** A tap is cut only by the Drill operation (`OpParams::Drill` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`, cycle `CycleChoice::Tap | FloatingTap`). Its fields are clearance/retract/top/bottom, cycle, peck, dwell, feed, plunge feed, holes and cross - no hand, no spindle direction.
- **The CL record.** `crates/cl/src/cl/cycle.rs`: `Cycle { kind, xy, r_z, bottom_z, entry_z, peck, dwell, first_move }` - no hand.
- **The reverse-spindle asks that do exist do not reach a tap.** `MillSpindle reverse` is written only for `OpParams::Thread { passes.spindle_reverse }` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs` ~1068, #988), and the Thread operation refuses a Tap-kind tool since #894 (`tool_law.rs` ~42: "A Tap is a rigid tap - one helical orbit of it is a crash"). `SpindleDirection reverse` (#629) comes only from `path.threads`, which only lathe single-point threading fills (`crates/motion/src/turning/thread_cycle.rs`).

So every tap a user can define is right-hand, and `G84` with `M3` on Mazak (and the other posts' tapping cycles) is the correct output for every tap the program can produce today. The defect as filed is unreachable; nothing was changed, no branch was pushed.

Per my brief I am not re-rating or reshaping this issue: the main session decides whether it becomes "support or refuse left-hand tapping" (a tool or Drill-op hand parameter, a `G74`/`M4` cycle per dialect or a named refusal per post) or is closed. Releasing the claim.

Re-rated by the filing session: the worker's evidence above shows no tap hand can be set today (tool, Drill operation and cycle record have none), so every tap a user can define is right-hand and G84 with M3 is correct. This is not a defect; it is now the enhancement "support left-hand taps" (P6). The Done-means line stands for whoever adds the hand parameter: each post writes the left-hand cycle with reverse spindle or refuses by name.
